units.sourceHTML: Wren is a small, fast, class-based concurrent scripting language #
units.originalInnerHTML: Wren is a small, fast, class-based concurrent scripting language #

units.sourceHTML: Think Smalltalk in a Lua-sized package with a dash of Erlang and wrapped up in a familiar, modern syntax.
units.originalInnerHTML: Think Smalltalk in a Lua-sized package with a dash of Erlang and wrapped up in a familiar, modern syntax.

units.sourceHTML: Wren is small. The VM implementation is under 4,000 semicolons. You can skim the whole thing in an afternoon. It’s small, but not dense. It is readable and lovingly-commented.
units.originalInnerHTML: Wren is small. The VM implementation is under 4,000 semicolons. You can skim the whole thing in an afternoon. It’s small, but not dense. It is readable and lovingly-commented.

units.sourceHTML: Wren is fast. A fast single-pass compiler to tight bytecode, and a compact object representation help Wren compete with other dynamic languages.
units.originalInnerHTML: Wren is fast. A fast single-pass compiler to tight bytecode, and a compact object representation help Wren compete with other dynamic languages.

units.sourceHTML: Wren is class-based. There are lots of scripting languages out there, but many have unusual or non-existent object models. Wren places classes front and center.
units.originalInnerHTML: Wren is class-based. There are lots of scripting languages out there, but many have unusual or non-existent object models. Wren places classes front and center.

units.sourceHTML: Wren is concurrent. Lightweight fibers are core to the execution model and let you organize your program into a flock of communicating coroutines.
units.originalInnerHTML: Wren is concurrent. Lightweight fibers are core to the execution model and let you organize your program into a flock of communicating coroutines.

units.sourceHTML: Wren is a scripting language. Wren is intended for embedding in applications. It has no dependencies, a small standard library, and an easy-to-use C API. It compiles cleanly as C99, C++98 or anything later.
units.originalInnerHTML: Wren is a scripting language. Wren is intended for embedding in applications. It has no dependencies, a small standard library, and an easy-to-use C API. It compiles cleanly as C99, C++98 or anything later.
